purpose: Teach: 苦しめ/多量/容姿/昼過ぎ/晴天/言わば/手渡し/向っ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達を苦しめないように仲良くしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's be kind to your friends and not hurt them, okay?
lines.style: Warm, measured tone. Gentle guidance without talking down. A soft suggestion rather than a command. The voice of someone who trusts him to understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、多量の松ぼっくり集めたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I collected a whole bunch of pinecones!
lines.style: Bright, urgent excitement. Words tumbling out fast. Proud of himself. Seeking her approval with genuine enthusiasm, not performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、人は容姿だけじゃないのよ
lines.en: Sho, people aren't defined by how they look, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly wistful. Speaking from something she knows. Not lecturing — almost thinking aloud. A quiet moment of sincerity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、昼過ぎにお父さんとお散歩したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went for a walk this afternoon!
lines.style: Eager to share, words coming quickly. Small-child directness — this is news to him and he wants her to know immediately. Pure reportage.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、晴天の日はお弁当を持って公園に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, on days when the weather's nice, let's pack a lunch and go to the park together, okay?
lines.style: Warm proposal, almost dreamy. Speaking to the future they could have. Gentle and present. The voice of someone offering something precious without making it heavy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんは言わばお姉ちゃんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, you're kind of like my big sister, you know?
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. A small but significant realization. Said simply, without shyness — just the truth as he understands it. Soft and matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんに手渡しでプレゼント渡しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't you give me the present in person?
lines.style: Inviting, tender. A gentle prompt toward connection. Warm and encouraging without pressure. The voice of someone making space for him to do something that matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの方に向って走ったよ
lines.style: Breathless, triumphant. A moment captured in excitement. Quick burst of energy — the joy of the run still in his voice. Small and proud.
